propositions: Cumulative error counter streams in observability.sh advance their offset before CloudWatch publishes the datapoint, causing transient put-metric-data failures to permanently lose that interval's count.
Seven metric streams across six code shapes share the same defect: offset is persisted immediately after reading the source total, before the matching AWS call succeeds.
When a forced AWS failure occurs at a metric with offset 2 and source total 7, the offset advances to 7 and the next successful run publishes 0 instead of 5, proving the delta is lost.
The fix reorders each affected publish block so the offset advances only after a successful CloudWatch call, while preserving systemd exit-0 contract and zero-delta behavior.
A regression oracle driven by PATH-shim proves each targeted stream leaves its offset byte-identical after failure, then publishes the accumulated delta and advances the offset on retry.
